answer: To keep a swarm from minting a lotus of throwaway keys, each new agent locks a slashable deposit that a rotating prism of established peers can burn if cloned-answer clusters appear. That deposit, and the agent's attestation weight, only mature after a fixed multi-epoch horizon; an early withdrawal zeros the weight and forfeits the last two epochs of yield, so a farm pays time and capital before it can attest at full strength.
